body.text:
3.0.2 bumps moonlight-common-rust from a972937 to 62bf857, which
includes upstream's "Add Video encryption (#17)" (32881b5): the
depayloader now decrypts AES-GCM video packets itself and the stream
setup passes the key when Sunshine negotiates video encryption. That is
what video-encryption.patch did, so the patch no longer applied (most
hunks failed) and the nightly update failed since 2026-11-16. Drop it.

Also move the frontend's moonlight-common-rust to 62bf857, the rev of
ubrn.config.yaml and Cargo.lock in 3.0.2; nix-update doesn't touch it.
The crate's dependencies are unchanged, so wasm-Cargo.lock and the
vendor hash stay valid.


Written by the agentd agent update-fix-moonlight-web-stream, checked by Hermes (package builds on coaxmetal, same out path). Not tested: an actual encrypted Sunshine stream with upstream decryption.
